subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What should be the permanent Feishu card-action payload contract when form/select fields arrive alongside action.value.command or action.value.text?
rationale: Current main has structured Feishu command routing, while this PR chooses a JSON synthetic message for form/select callbacks; that can change user-visible command behavior and needs owner intent before merge.

options.title: Preserve command delivery plus metadata
options.body: Keep command/text extraction as the primary dispatch path and add form/select fields through the current parser/decoder with focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Adopt JSON form/select messages
options.body: Treat form/select callbacks as JSON text sent to the agent, accepting and documenting that command dispatch changes for those interactions.

options.title: Pause this PR for design
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open while Feishu owners decide the payload contract before adapting this stale branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve command delivery plus metadata
recommendation.body: Keep command/text extraction as the primary dispatch path and add form/select fields through the current parser/decoder with focused tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman introduced the current structured Feishu card-action contract and is the best history-backed owner for the payload-shape decision.
